text:
jordan_p: Thinking about a "rollback-safe" mode for partners when we roll breaking SDK changes. Idea: partners opt into a runtime flag that keeps legacy endpoints alive + automatic fallback for 48h. Also need a marketplace + joint-announcement cadence. Thoughts?

maya_pm: +1. We should pair that with a dry-run window (1 week) where telemetry is collected but defaults stay on old behavior. That gives partners time to test.

tsai_eng: Implementation question — is the fallback per-request header based, or a routing-level shim? Prefer header + feature flag so partners can toggle per-client.

jordan_p: header approach seems simplest. quick sketch: ```http
POST /v1/generate
Headers:
  x-rw-sdk-version: 4.0.0
  x-rw-fallback: legacy
```
If server sees incompatible version + fallback header, route to compat-handler.

luke_partners: Ops note: partners will want a clear "how this impacts me" doc and an announcement email. We should offer a partner-facing dry-run URL and a specific window for marketplace listings to update.

maya_pm: timeline suggestion: announce intent to partners 3w before flip, open opt-in dry-run 2w before, canary 1w before, full switch after 48h successful telemetry. For marketplace public announcement, coordinate on the day of full switch.

tsai_eng: On the infra side we'll need a canary rollout plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h with automatic rollback on error-rate spikes. I can add an autoscale-safe job to handle the routing rules.

infra-bot: deploy-check: scheduled rollout job created by tsai_eng. Job ID: roll-safe-3310002222. Add @oncall if >1% error increase.

jordan_p: Partner tooling ask: expose a telemetry endpoint that reports fallback hits, latency, and token delta so partners can validate impact. Should be opt-in for privacy.

luke_partners: We'll prepare an outreach template + support rota. Suggest dedicated office hours for first 72h after switch. Also include rollback playbook for partners who need extended runway.

maya_pm: Docs: create a new section "SDK compatibility & rollback-safe mode" with examples (Node, Python) and a FAQ. I'll own the docs PR.

tsai_eng: I'll mock a shim handler and share a link to a repo branch by EOD. Need product sign-off on header names and timelines.

jordan_p: Decisions so far: 3w partner notice, 2w dry-run opt-in, canary 1w, 48h fallback window at full switch. Owners: maya_pm (docs & partner comms), luke_partners (partner ops), tsai_eng (infra shims + rollout), jordan_p (product signoff). Agree? :thumbsup:

maya_pm: agree :thumbsup:

luke_partners: agree, will draft comms and calendar invites.

tsai_eng: agree, starting infra work.

jordan_p: I'll draft the marketplace announcement cadence and share a short checklist tomorrow. Thanks everyone.
